parts.title: January 2026
parts.html:
Speakers and election bodies meet

  • 28th CSPOC (Conference of Speakers and Presiding Officers of the Commonwealth), 14–16 January, New Delhi: opened by the PM in the Central Hall of the old Parliament, chaired by Om Birla; 61 Speakers from 42 countries. India hosted it earlier in 1971, 1986 and 2010.
  • 86th AIPOC (All India Presiding Officers Conference), 19–21 January at the UP Vidhan Sabha, Lucknow; theme 'Strong Legislature – Prosperous Nation'; resolutions include a National Legislative Index and at least 30 sittings a year.
  • IICDEM-2026 (democracy and election management), 21–23 January, New Delhi, by IIIDEM; adopted the 5-pillar Delhi Declaration 2026. India chairs International IDEA in 2026.
  • At IICDEM the Election Commission launched ECINet – a one-stop platform merging 40+ ECI apps and portals.

Energy, aviation and trade fairs

  • India Energy Week 2026 (4th edition), 27–30 January, Goa, by the Petroleum Ministry; opened virtually by the PM.
  • Wings India 2026, 28–31 January at Begumpet Airport, Hyderabad – Asia's largest civil aviation event.
  • 9th Indusfood, Greater Noida, by the Trade Promotion Council of India; APEDA launched the BHARATI initiative for agri-tech start-ups.
  • National Textile Ministers' Conference, Guwahati: Tex-RAMPS MoUs with 15 states.
  • Abroad: India was partner country for the first time at Gulfood 2026 (Dubai); Intersec 2026 (Dubai) is the largest security and fire-safety show; 16th IRENA Assembly in Abu Dhabi; 4th One Billion Followers Summit, UAE ('Content for Good').
India Energy Week: started in 2023; organised by the Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas as a global meet on energy security and transition.

Faith, heritage and culture

  • 2nd Global Buddhist Summit, 24–25 January, New Delhi, by the International Buddhist Confederation and Ministry of Culture; showcased the AI tool 'Kalyan Mitra' (NORBU). The first summit was in April 2023.
  • PM opened the Piprahwa relics exhibition 'The Light and the Lotus: Relics of the Awakened One' on 3 January at Rai Pithora Cultural Complex, Delhi. The relics, found in 1898 by W.C. Peppe, came back to India in July 2025.
  • Somnath Swabhiman Parv, 8–11 January: 1,000 years since Mahmud of Ghazni's raid (1026 AD) and 75 years of the rebuilt temple (opened 11 May 1951 by Dr Rajendra Prasad).
  • 25th Bharat Rang Mahotsav by the National School of Drama, 27 January–20 February, theme 'Samvad Sanskritiyon Ka'; world's largest international theatre festival.
  • 53rd New Delhi World Book Fair, 10–18 January (NBT with ITPO): theme on Indian military history; guest of honour Qatar, focus country Spain.
  • 49th International Kolkata Book Fair: focus country Argentina.
  • PM attended Bagurumba Dahou 2026 in Guwahati on 17 January – the Bodo community's traditional dance festival.
  • 3rd Indian Lighthouse Festival in Visakhapatnam; Bharat Parv 2026 (Ministry of Tourism), 26–31 January, Delhi.
  • 9th Siddha Day in Chennai, theme 'Siddha for Global Health'.
Somnath Temple: Prabhas Patan, Gujarat; first of the 12 Jyotirlingas; rebuilt after Independence on Sardar Patel's initiative.

Youth, education and policy meets

  • 2nd Viksit Bharat Young Leaders Dialogue, 9–12 January, New Delhi, by the Department of Youth Affairs, for youth aged 15–29.
  • Inclusive Education Summit 2026, 21–23 January, New Delhi (Ministry of Education).
  • Conference on restoring the Aravallis: 'Strengthening the Aravalli Green Wall'.
  • 2nd India–Sri Lanka Hindi Conference held in Colombo.
  • 6th ASEAN–India Digital Ministers' Meeting, co-chaired by India and Vietnam.
